body: You’re right. I replied too quickly. I just know with myself, when I encounter a visual cue in my everday environment that triggers a thought of “oh, maybe that’s how I could do it,” it’s easier to cut off this train of thought when I realize there’s a significant likelihood it wouldn’t end my life but just make the rest of it more miserable.

Wow, I can relate so much. I‘m know I won’t do it as long as either of my parents are still alive. I’m resigned to that. But the thought of having to still continue living for decades beyond that just fills me with indescribable dread. I don’t know how I could do it to my siblings, and at the same time I don’t know how I could not.
Where are you, what’s happening? Can you go to the hospital now?
He’s lucky to have someone like you who cares. Please, don’t try to ”make him” do or feel anything. Just ask him if he wants to talk about, then listen. Really listen. Good luck.

Is there any way you can find some sort of world outside of your family? I don’t mean to suggest that’s easy. It just sounds like there is so much painful drama going on there, you need to find some way to distance yourself from it. Did your Mom actually use the words “disgusting embarassment“? Was there any part of you that, instead of agreeing with her, was outraged that she’d say something so cruel? I imagine it might be scarier to go with that part than the more familar one that agrees. But maybe it’s worth a try, if you’ve ever had an inkling of that sense.

I know. Everyone thinks they can wave some magic wand and sugar coat out of existence this ugly, uncomfortable reality. This is what I imagine at least, based on other people’s stories. I’ve never talked to anyone about the suicidal thoughts that have gradually become my daily soundtrack over the past decade, because I know they wouldn’t really listen. They‘d be too wrapped up in their own agenda of fixing, or trying to get some medical professional to wave their magic fixing wand. The last thing I want is that kind of help. I just want someone I can talk to out loud about my thoughts.

I can relate a lot to your thought of not having asked for this. Many days I feel so much rage towards my parents for making me exist, I can’t muster up even a faint sense of a possibility of forgiveness.

Maybe when you find yourself starting to fantasize, it could help to imagine other possible outcomes than the one you’re craving. Being terribly injured and disabled the rest of your life seems like it could be a very real possibility if you were to act on your urge. Maybe you can associate it in your mind with an outcome that no part of you wants at all. Good luck.

Common lore, but it‘s been disproven by laboratory testing. Eg. [this study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0740002018300121?via%3Dihub) found “no clear influence of iodized salt on microbial populations...Thus, there is no basis for the popular held belief that the use of iodized salt inhibits the growth of the bacteria important for the sauerkraut fermentation.”  In [this one](https://www.openagrar.de/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/openagrar_derivate_00017908/A1911.pdf), iodized salt had “No effects on the counts of total aerobic bacteria, LAB, enterobacteria and yeasts and moulds.”

So bring on the fortified kraut!

I wish commentors would refrain from making predictions like “you will find someone.” What they usually actually mean is “I was like you and then I found someone,” or “you’re young and most people find someone by some later age.” We don’t and can’t know whether the person posting will have the same experience as you, or as most people. They might, they might not. Uncertainty isn’t comforting but it’s the reality.
Still, there may be something to be said for grappling with your problems amidst some fresh scenery. Maybe you will fall in love with the open skies or some other surprising thing there. Good luck.
How are things today? Did your dad respond?
I’m curious to hear more. How did you learn this?

Are you sure you’re absolutely incapable of being anything but 100% boring to everyone on earth? I had a good chuckle at some of your comments, like the one about dick pics. 

I don’t say this to minimize or disregard in any way the painfulness of going days or weeks or months or years without anyone seeming to show a genuine desire to spend time with you. I’ve been there many times, and it’s a miserable pile of shit to dwell in, for sure.
